top_comments.text: My oncologist told me diet has zero effect on cancer. She also told me I'd die if I didn't follow her advice. Well, 3 years later, I'm NED and I didn't follow her advice. I learned a lot along the way, mostly that cancer is not a disease, it's a natural healing mechanism to a trauma. That trauma could be emotional, physical, spiritual or chemical, but the body deals with it by proliferating cells to surround it, what we call cancer. Once the trauma is fully sealed, it's called a benign tumour. If the trauma continues, so the body has to keep proliferating cells, we're told the cancer has metastasised. Therapeutic ketosis will stop the growth, as the cells predominantly use glucose, but not eliminate the cancer until you deal with the trauma. So for everyone dealing with cancer, eat zero carbs to give yourself time, and deal with the trauma (German New Medicine is a good place to start). If you don't know what it is (most of us don't, do everything you can!). For me, my breast cancer was probably from an emotional cause, so emotional release was a big part of my healing alongside detoxing, sunlight, grounding, fasting, saunas, energy healing and everything else I could throw at it. Just in case.
